place.name: Estádio Nacional
place.description: The Estádio Nacional (English: National Stadium), also known as Estádio do Jamor, Estádio Nacional do Jamor or Estádio de Honra (English: Stadium of Honour), is a multi-purpose stadium located within the Centro Desportivo Nacional do Jamor (English: Jamor National Sports Centre). Located in the municipality of Oeiras some 12 kilometres from the centre of the national capital Lisbon, the stadium has a capacity of 37,593 spectators.
